notes.title: Patch 1.0.1c
notes.content:
📢 Update: On the Peril of Parrots!

[list]
[*] P.O.L.L.I should no longer afraid of "frogs".  All "hop" puzzles should now be solvable. 
[*] Players can now reset their run by entering konami code (UP,UP, DOWN, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, LEFT, RIGHT,  B, A) at the main menu screen 
[*] Improved player input performance.
[/list]

We continue to be immensely grateful for your valuable feedback and continuous support.
As always, please let us know if you have any further suggestions or feedback.

Best regards,
The Development Team

We are immensely grateful for your valuable feedback and continuous support.
As always, please let us know if you have any further suggestions or feedback.

The Development Team

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games is going live September 11 - 14!
notes.content:
[h2]Get ready![/h2]

Join us September 11 - 14 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Save & Sound features concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 3-day live show from September 11 - 13 will showcase original content made just for Save & Sound. 

[h2]Don’t miss out on updates![/h2]

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website, YouTube, and Twitch. Check out all the games part of the event on [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1a
notes.content:
📢 Update: On the Peril of Parrots!

After receiving valuable feedback from our amazing players, we've been hard at work making some exciting improvements to On the Peril of Parrots.

[list]
[*] Enhanced Settings: We've listened to your requests and have expanded the settings feature to include both audio and visual settings. These are accessible from the main menu.
[*] Refined Gameplay: We've made significant tweaks to the gameplay to better highlight the key systems and mechanics of the game.
[*] Bug Fixes: We've identified and addressed the reported unsolvable puzzles. 
[/list]

We are immensely grateful for your valuable feedback and continuous support.
As always, please let us know if you have any further suggestions or feedback.

Best regards,
The Development Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0f
notes.content:
Dear players,

A fresh small patch to address a reported error.
This update should fix the following:

[list]
[*] Added basic menu settings - accessible via pressing ESC on the main menu or in game
[*] Changed the behaviour of entering the <SECRET CODE> on the main menu
[*] Updated main menu to better represent narrative progress
[*] Implemented minor design change to make discovering a hidden menu ... easier
[*] Updated "Free Mode" to be more chill & fun
[/list]


We hope these changes will improve your experience with the game, and we appreciate your continued support. As always, please let us know if you have any further suggestions or feedback.

Best regards,
The Development Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0d
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you so much for trying out our game and sharing your valuable feedback. We've been listening to your comments and we're excited to announce that we have an update ready for you! 
See the details beow:

[list]
[*] Addressed puzzles C-311, C-312, C-505 to make them more solvable.
[*] Addressed the softlock that occurred during the score tally, so that you can now proceed smoothly.
[*] Disabled the background animations to improve the frame rate issues that some players were experiencing.
[*] Added the functionality to return to the main menu by pressing ESC.
[/list]

We hope these changes will improve your experience with the game, and we appreciate your continued support. As always, please let us know if you have any further suggestions or feedback.

Best regards,
The Development Team
